```{r}

library(apaTables)
```

Body text before.

The chunk below carries NO `tbl-` label, and that absence is the whole
test (fix round 1, Important). Task 6 made rotation reachable for an
unlabelled chunk (`apatablelandscape.lua` finds its own marker div via a
Pandoc-level walk, not a `FloatRefTarget` handler), which also made
reachable a defect in the shrink-ladder filter that predates Task 6: it was
scoped to `FloatRefTarget` only, so an unlabelled wide table would rotate
but silently keep the default 10 pt table style, leaving its own marker
div stranded, unread, in the rendered document. That filter now uses the
same Pandoc-level walk this one does. (This paragraph deliberately avoids
spelling out the marker's own class name as a literal string, since the
structural test reading this rendered document checks the OUTPUT does not
contain it -- and this prose would otherwise be a false positive against
its own check.)

```{r}
#| label: standin-not-a-float
#| echo: false
set.seed(1)
d14 <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(30 * 14), ncol = 14))
names(d14) <- paste0("Var", 1:14)
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(d14))
```

Body text after.
